review_candidates.title: C-Level Office (all genders) in Berlin
review_candidates.description: We're building the future of urban stays. One city at a time. Homaris exists to solve one of the most persistent problems in modern cities: People from abroad need places to live, work, and just feel at home. We build and operate fully digitised serviced apartments across Germany´s major cities – next step: Europe and beyond. And a product vision — the nanopartment® — that reimagines what urban stays can look like in the smallest possible space. Revenue triples within two years — organically. No venture capital. No exit strategy. We are in this for the long run, and we build accordingly. Extraordinary people make this happen - and we're looking for one more. Your Role You will work directly with the Executive Board. This is not a coordination role. You will be embedded in the decision-making layer of a company that is scaling from a German market leader to a European one. You will know everything that matters, before most people know it matters. You will make things happen that wouldn´t happen without you. This opportunity is designed for someone who has worked successfully in a demanding, fast-moving environment and is ready to take on broad responsibility, contribute at senior level and grow with Homaris. What You'll Do Run the operating rhythm of the Board. You don't just manage schedules — You will bring structure, judgement and momentum to the topics that shape the company. Be the trusted interface to the outside world. Investors, partners, property owners, key clients. You become the person they know, trust, and hear back from quickly. You manage relationships with the same care the Board would — because you represent them. Think ahead. You spot the bottleneck before it forms. You prepare the briefing before it's asked for. You flag the conflict in the calendar three weeks out. You work half a step ahead of everyone else in the room, and you make it look effortless. Drive strategic projects. You don't just support decisions — you contribute to them. You take on cross-functional projects, coordinate between teams, and bring things to a close. You are comfortable owning outcomes, not just tasks. What Makes You a Fit You've supported a C-Level or founder before. In a company where things moved fast and the margin for error was low. You know what it means to be trusted with everything and to earn that trust every day. You're genuinely excited about AI. You already use it to work faster and better. You don't wait for tools to be handed to you. You stay calm under pressure. When things get complicated — and they will — you slow down, think clearly, and help others do the same. Your presence signals that things are under control. Ownership. You see something that needs doing and you do it. You follow through. You don't need to be asked twice. Sharp judgment. You know what matters and what doesn't. You read situations quickly. You know when to act and when to wait. Discretion. You will have access to everything. That comes with responsibility, and you take it seriously. Presence. You are based in Berlin, or ready to be – and you love to work together – in person - because that's how good work happens. The Environment Homaris is a company with the maximum of long-term orientation. We don't burn cash to grow fast and sell. We build something real, and we expect the people who join us to want to build it with us — not to optimise for others. The pace is high. The problems are real. The team is small enough that every person matters. We're not always great at seeing and celebrating our wins. But we're working on it — and we'd love your help with that. What We Offer We define levels by the work you own and the decisions you're accountable for, not by your title or years of experience. Beyond that: we've thought carefully about what people actually need to do their best work and live well — and we've built a benefits package that reflects that. Health, mobility, development, flexibility, and a few perks that come with being in the travel and hospitality business. Not much is missing. We'll walk you through the details when we meet. Next Steps If this opportunity resonates with you, we’d be glad to learn more about your experience and perspective. Just send us your CV. Questions? Reach out to Natalie at karriere@homaris.de or +49 157 92465807. We value diversity and welcome applications from people of all genders, cultures and backgrounds. About Us Homaris is a leading provider of serviced nano-apartments in prime urban locations and is pioneering a new generation of space-efficient apartment concepts with its nanopartment®. With more than 4,500 apartments secured under contract in cities including Berlin, Hamburg, Munich, Cologne, Frankfurt, Stuttgart, Düsseldorf and Dresden, Homaris ranks among Germany’s leading serviced-apartment brands. The company serves contemporary customer segments, including business travellers, tourists, digital nomads and corporate clients. The Homaris concept is based on the integration of a fully digitalised guest journey with maximum space efficiency, multifunctional design and intelligent space solutions. The nanopartment® is Homaris’s signature product, embodying innovative space efficiency, modern minimalism and a modular design concept that combines living, working and a sense of arrival within a compact footprint. Rotating, folding and sliding mechanisms allow the space to be reconfigured according to individual needs. In the future, the system is intended to become a standard feature across Homaris’s upcoming properties.

Conduct site observations and inspections of roofing and building enclosure systems. Interpret drawings, figures, and site plans; perform drafting or CAD work as needed. Develop testing plans and perform specialized building enclosure testing. Interpret test results, identify deficiencies, and recommend corrective actions. Perform building enclosure investigations, forensic assessments, and commissioning (BECx). Perform new construction design reviews and design of repairs to existing building envelope components. Perform peer review of design documents, specifications, and submittals. Maintain knowledge of applicable building codes and standards including IBC, ASHRAE, ASTM, SMACNA, and CSI. Project Management Manage building science & infrastructure projects from setup through completion. Coordinate project teams and direct site activities with field staff, subcontractors, and senior managers. Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining schedule, scope, and budget objectives. Prepare and review proposals, change orders, budgets, and invoices. Monitor project progress and communicate schedule updates, testing activities, and potential budget impacts. Communicate project milestones with clients and advise on significant project changes. Client Interaction & Business Development Interface with clients regularly and lead project meetings and discussions. Present testing results, project findings, and recommendations to clients. Maintain and develop client relationships and support growth of the client database. Team Leadership & Collaboration Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams on project execution. Mentor junior staff and supervise field personnel performing inspections and testing. Coordinate staffing needs with other managers to support project execution. Documentation & Reporting Prepare building science & infrastructure reports, perform analysis, and provide recommendations. Ensure reports meet professional standards for clarity, accuracy, and technical content. Review and approve reports prepared by junior staff prior to Principal review. Additional Responsibilities Perform other duties as assigned. Qualifications Education & Experience Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Architectural Engineering, Architecture (NCARB), or a related field. 5+ years of related experience with building enclosure consulting, including field investigations, testing, commissioning (BECx), design review, or forensic assessments. Licensed or certified in at least one of the following preferred but not required: Professional Engineer (P.E.) Registered Architect (R.A.) IIBEC certifications (RRC, RWC, REWC, RBEC, CBECxP) University of Wisconsin-Madison certifications (BECxP, CxA+BE) Knowledge & Skills Strong knowledge of building science, building enclosure systems, and construction practices. Strong knowledge of building codes, materials, and structural or architectural systems. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong project management and consulting skills. Ability to manage multiple projects and lead multidisciplinary teams. Strong judgment, critical thinking, and decision-making abilities. Physical Requirements Ability to lift up to 40 pounds multiple times per day, stand for extended periods, walk on uneven terrain, and perform work at heights. Additional Requirements Valid driver’s license required if driving for or on behalf of an ECS subsidiary. Why Join ECS? Nationwide Building Science + Infrastructure Consulting practice made up of more than 180 employees with deep technical expertise and opportunities for collaboration across the country Opportunity to lead high-profile projects with technical complexity and visibility Be part of a growing and innovative team focused on technical excellence and client service Supportive work environment that values expertise, collaboration, and continuous learning Competitive salary, performance bonuses, and comprehensive benefits ECS is an employee-owned company with an Employee Stock Ownership program (ESOP)! 401(k) with up to 4% match Tuition Assistance Program And more!
